verdict.rationale: Green & Spiegel is an immigration law firm, so a structured O-1A qualification assessment is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack never mentions O-1A, extraordinary-ability criteria, or any documented evaluation method applied before filing. It shows only generic consultations, end-to-end support claims, a start-up practice and a J-1 incubator pathway, none of which are the requested capability.

support.subject: As a founder, I can get a structured O-1A qualification assessment — the provider documents how it evaluates my extraordinary-ability evidence against the USCIS criteria before anything is filed
